headline: No scored AI news; endings hold their ground
body: A completely quiet day. Nothing was scored, and no earlier announcements were fading yet, so every ending and world factor stayed put. Yesterday's darker tilt, from Google's Pentagon deal and the UK sabotage study, simply carries over into today unchanged. Enslaved God still leads the table. Horizon Balance holds at +1.67.
